summary: B6: search language (parser, compiler), saved filters
description:
Landed in:
- DevHub-Plugins `b4e6d79`: B3 (Core) + B6 (Core): sprint data in Board.Core; the search language (parser with positions in errors, compiler: names or ids, people, sprints and date functions, relative dates, durations, custom fields, ORDER BY); board operations (boards, columns that create their status, rename, move, merge, delete with or without statuses, statuses per column, WIP limits, quick filters, MoveCard = transition + rank); BoardLayout (filters, quick filters, search, assignees, Scrum shows the active sprint, Kanban hides old Done issues, swimlanes, statuses not on the board); 104 tests
